_comment: R4 Context shadow rebind. saveTargets is deliberately empty: the sources are already saved on TradingView and this rollout must only rebind the overlay inputs and SAVE THE LAYOUT. bindingLabels is omitted so the labels are parsed from SMC_Context_Overlay.pine itself, which is what makes the rebind follow the current 62-channel contract instead of a frozen list. repairE2ETarget is omitted on purpose: the repair drill deliberately drifts a binding first, which has no place on a shadow layout being brought up to contract.
